summary: Closed the active_goal dead-write gap: generate-task-order.sh now resolves the Goal line via a unified resolve_goal_text() precedence chain (--goal override > non-empty active_goal > existing TODO.md Goal line > omit), shared identically by --print and --update-todo, replacing the mode-gated resolution that made --print never render a Goal line at all. Five red-then-green regression cases were added and the precedence/conflict rule documented. Deployed and closed the live reproduction end to end (specs/TODO.md now renders the Goal line from specs/state.json's active_goal). Phase 4 closed [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] for two sibling-owned, pre-existing deploy-gate failures (eager-load budget, skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md ceiling) confirmed unrelated to this task's file_scope; three other transient gate timeouts under batch concurrency were confirmed clean on standalone rerun.
